build_lexicon_graph: build a graph that transduces letters to word pieces using a lexicon and letter-to-index mapping
build_token_graph: build a graph with individual token transition models that consume one or more consecutive word pieces
compose_word_decomposition: compose a word recognition graph with a lexicon graph to compute all possible word decompositions
compute_alignment_graph: compute the alignment graph by composing token graphs with decomposition graphs for sequence alignment
calculate_sequence_loss: calculate the sequence level loss by subtracting forward scores of intersected emissions and alignment graphs
